cues.zh: 一旦理解預訓練與微調，就會發現，這些模型真的

cues.en: versatile and can be trained to do basically anything that is language mediated or anything that can be represented as tokens.
cues.zh: 非常多用途，基本上，任何透過語言，或能表示成詞元的事，都能訓練。

cues.en: So building a language model and worrying about the details of the architecture is important.
cues.zh: 所以，建立語言模型、關注架構細節很重要，

cues.en: And I don't want to understate that point, but the training data that you use can entirely determine
cues.zh: 我不想淡化這點；但訓練資料能完全決定

cues.en: how the model behaves, what the model knows, and what it's like to interact with the model.
cues.zh: 模型如何行動、知道什麼，以及互動起來是什麼感覺。
